data.one_liner: Package to parse iCalendar (.ics) files written in pure Dart.
data.what_it_does: Parses iCalendar (.ics) string contents or lines into a structured ICalendar object. Supports conversion to JSON format and registering or unregistering custom fields.
use_when: You need to parse .ics calendar files or data strings in a pure Dart or Flutter application.
You want to convert calendar events and properties into a JSON-compatible map.
avoid_when: You need to write, manage, or fully sync iCalendar files back to a remote calendar provider.
strengths: Written in pure Dart supporting multiple platforms (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux).
Allows custom field registration and unregistration for parsing unsupported properties.
Provides straightforward methods like ICalendar.fromString and ICalendar.fromLines.
weaknesses: Relies on a fixed set of natively supported properties unless custom fields are manually registered.
